purpose: Three review-only body-mechanics refinements of approved motion profile A, comparing hip weight transfer, torso counter-rotation, lateral lean, and recoil recovery without changing the selected stride or peak recoil.
camera: one measured orthographic gameplay camera pitched downward exactly 45 degrees
facing: fixed down-right three-quarter gameplay yaw for all gait and recoil samples
lighting: approved neutral diagnostic body and orange independent rifle under identical controlled preview lighting
prompt: No generated imagery is used. Inherit approved PlayerMotionRig profile A exactly, then add a review-only mechanics layer that compares three bounded hip and torso profiles across six gait and six recoil phases while preserving the independent rifle, exact 45-degree camera, fixed yaw, complete source topology, floor clearance, and both-hand plus stock constraints.
negative_constraints: no change to profile A stride 0.15, lift 0.085, shoulder bob 0.010, or four-degree peak recoil
no whole-body yaw spin, screen-space gun rotation, detached hand, floating stock, foot penetration, skating, or identical left and right foot travel
no identity, camera, yaw, scale, material, framing, topology, or weapon-geometry drift between refinements
no 120-frame expansion, production atlas replacement, Player.gd change, collision change, or gameplay integration before A1/A2/A3 selection

references.role: approved balanced gait and four-degree recoil amplitude
approved grip deformation and depth proof
approved body geometry and complete topology

candidate_outputs.focus: restrained stability and fast recoil recovery
realistic load transfer and two-stage recoil recovery
strong counter-motion and slower overshoot recovery

generation_model: Godot 4.7 inherited Skeleton3D review rig, deterministic pelvis/torso pose layer, retained analytic arm and leg constraints, and SubViewport rendering

selection_approval.scope: hip weight transfer, pelvis and torso counter-rotation, lateral lean, recoil torso response, and recovery curve only
